service.description: Each listener with a switch (HTTP, HTTPS, gRPC, SSH, SMTP, XMPP, SIP, Call media, TURN), then the registry's others (the cluster port). For each: name, state (on, off, failed, skipped; not-running when this process runs no listeners, as under moqui test, where the row comes from the conf alone), detail, since, cause (who or what changed it last, and why), address, live (a change applies while the server runs; until then it waits for a restart, pending), lastError, connections, dependents (what turning it off would end: the edge node's SSH tunnel, the cluster's SSH transport), switchable, wayIn (HTTPS, HTTP and SSH), enabled (its switch in the running conf), ownRequest (the caller's request came over it) and settingList: each setting behind it with selector, envName, value, source (conf file with file, fileLabel and line; runtime/.env; the environment; -D; or set while running and not kept past a restart). A listener with a switch also has portSelector and port, hostSelector and host (null where it has none), ownSettingList (each own setting a change takes: name, selector, value, values) and subServiceList (the services carried on it that a switch of their own turns off for everyone, SSH's terminal client, SFTP, git and admin shell: each a setting with title and on). HTTPS, HTTP and SSH also have reachable (on, at an address clients reach, as the lockout guard counts it) and HTTP plainPublic (on at a public address with no proxy believed in front, as the public HTTP guard sees it). While listeners run, one the registry has no entry of (TURN, which call media starts) is its startup report row. Also running (listeners run in this process), origin (the listener the caller's request came over) and recentChanges: the changes people made on this server since it started, from set#Listener and the operator socket, newest first, at most 20, each with time, name, who, from, to, reason, applied, outcome, endNow and persist (a change that changed no setting is not listed). Needs the ADMIN group.

Turn one listener on or off, and optionally move it (port, host) or set its own settings (access, SSH's: open, login or key). Needs the ADMIN group, the sealed LISTENER_CONTROL permission and a recent sign-in ("Confirm it is you"), in that order (reasonCode permission or reauthRequired). Then, each refused with its reasonCode: invalid (no such listener, a port that is not 1 to 65535, a host the listener cannot bind, an own setting or value it does not take, or no reason to turn it off, or a reason that is not one line of at most 500 characters); portBusy (the port it would bind is held, and by what); lockout (it leaves none of HTTPS, HTTP and SSH on at an address clients reach, SSH on loopback being none, nor HTTP or HTTPS on loopback unless trusted-proxies names a loopback address for a proxy on this machine: turning off the last way in, or moving it to loopback; the message names the ways back from where the change is kept, first moqui operator listener NAME on over the operator socket, then runtime/.env and systemctl reload, or a restart); publicHttp (it turns plain HTTP on at a public address, http-bind empty or not loopback, while trusted-proxies is empty); dependents (it turns SSH off while the edge tunnel or the cluster's SSH transport uses it). A guard's refusal asks for the confirmation in words and names in confirm the parameter that lets it through. Only the settings whose value changes are kept, as persist says (runtime/.env, or this process until a restart when the environment names one; persist=false sets them until the process ends) and one pass of the listener registry applies them, with the user and the reason as its cause; endNow ends the connections of a listener turned off at once instead of after 5 seconds, except those of the listener the request came over. A change that affects that listener applies a second after this answer. A switch has no timer: what is turned off stays off until someone turns it on. Logged on moqui.monitor.audit, a refusal too, and as a config annotation on the Monitor charts. Out: name, enabled, applied (now, deferred, no-listeners, failed), message, settingList (each selector, envName, value, previous, kept, outrankedBy, applies, note), outcomeList (each listener's name, action, detail) and noteList.
